label: QUASISTATIC_FLUID_ACCESSIBILITY_PROXY
method: Freudenthal six-tetra subdivision of the actual reference lattice, including fixed anchors as occlusion geometry
support: All six original tetra bonds live, positive signed volume ratio; surface has three actual original material IDs and live edge bonds. Auxiliary tetrahedra carry no mass/stiffness and do not change native mechanics.
gap: Six-edge local graph disconnected AND positive volume AND (Vcurrent/Vref-1)*dx > aperture_min. Failed support alone is not fluid.
portal: Shared actual triangular face local graph disconnected AND area-dilation proxy (A/Aref-1)*dx > aperture_min; gap cells connect through such portals to an outer portal.
new_face: Boundary of a fully supported material tetra against an exterior-connected open gap; opposing node normal-height increase > aperture_min. Each unique triangle mapped once.
regularization: C1 smooth aperture gate from 1 to 5 um, same factor on drive and drag
classification: original/new/open/accessibility are geometry flags; detached is orthogonal actual native component flag, not a second added force
geometric_limitations: Node-centered support-complex boundary is a resolution-dependent proxy, not unique continuum crack location.
Damaged connected cells, inverted/closed cells, sheet/chain/fine components without 3D supported tetra remain unresolved.
Local void transmission ignores nonlocal bond lines as impermeable solid tubes; long live bridges still determine material connectivity. No fiber radii or pore flow model supplied.
No guaranteed lower bound on true continuum wetted area; unresolved true area cannot be measured from point data alone. Report candidate-area and component coverage, never claim zero unknown area.
Finite point-probe visibility cannot certify a continuous liquid corridor or resolve subgrid throats/self-contact. No infiltration PDE. Report this approximation and probe rejections.
mass: Native original node IDs, volumes and mass are untouched; auxiliary volume is NOT native material volume.
transaction: Geometry is pure current-state recomputation; only accepted commit changes cumulative exposure. No rejected predictor changes damage/surface history.
current_occlusion: Gap-cell centroid, portal centroid and two outward face probes at 1/3 um must lie outside every current fully supported tetra (KD-tree broad phase and exact barycentric point containment). Occluded candidates remain unresolved.
